lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: You've done a good job supervising them in the written exam.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Next up, we have the practical exam.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: As I mentioned previously,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: you'll be participating as a sort of simulated commander.
Where do I need to go?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: The surface.
Come again?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Mm-hm.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: You will be proceeding to the surface.
And what will I be doing there?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: The only thing you can do up on the surface.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: You will be engaging with Raptures.
You're kidding.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: There's no need to worry.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: A few members of our faculty will be your escort.
But I'm going to be engaging with actual Raptures?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Well, it's not as if there are any fake Raptures on the surface, are there?
What if something unexpected happens?
What if there are more Raptures than we anticipated?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Then they will have to adapt and overcome.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Just like numerous Nikkes have done before them.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: If they cannot do that, then they will die.
What kind of screwed-up exam is this?!

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Our exams are meant to serve a practical purpose.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Therefore, you must evaluate the students

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: as if they were active-duty Nikkes,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: and you were their commander, participating in an actual reclamation mission on the surface.
But they're only students!

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: They are.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: But they are also Nikkes.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: This is what they were created for.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: This school was created to see if it was possible to enhance Nikkes' battlefield acumen through higher education.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Students here learn how to become better Nikkes,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: and how to use the specialized equipment

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: granted by M.M.R. more effectively.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Irregular testing administered throughout the semester helps them hone these skills,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: which they then learn how to apply in practical situations.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: With the final exam,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: all of their accomplishments must be both showcased and put to the test.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: It is for that reason that we choose to hold the exam up on the surface.
But even so, surely you can see that these methods are cruel and unusual.
You make the students sound like test subjects.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: You're right. It is cruel.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: this time will be different.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: They will not be proceeding to the surface.
And why is that?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Just this once,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: we will be holding the exam in the school's training room.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: We have received many requests from interested parties wishing to spectate.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Therefore, we are making an exception and changing the locale indoors

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: so that an audience will be able to observe the students' performances.
So this is all just to please an audience?
I presume that means next year, it will once again be held on the surface?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: This is a one-time exception.
Is there no way to prevent the exam from being held on the surface in the subsequent years?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: No, none.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: The curriculum is determined by M.M.R.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: We are powerless to change it.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: At least for the time being.
And are you okay with all of this?
Do you really feel it's acceptable to have the students take this kind of exam?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: There is much about this school that I disapprove of.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: More than you can possibly imagine.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I oppose almost everything here.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I've spoken enough. Let's go.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I will introduce you to the students who will be joining you.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Hey, Teacher!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Are you gonna be our commander?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: You're gonna be in our squad?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Ahem.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Everyone, please be quiet and return to your seats.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Yes, Miss.
Ein, Zwei, and Rei all sit in their seats.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Wait.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Where is Tercera?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Not sure.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Haven't seen her since the written exam.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Has anyone else seen her?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: She seemed really depressed after the written exam.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: So I gave her a chocolate.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Looks like it didn't work. She's not here.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Maybe she was depressed 'cause she felt she bombed the exam.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: She's been stressing a whole lot about whether she'd do well or not.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: We'll pass on all the relevant information to her.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Right now, I think she wants to be left alone.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Then let's begin.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: As I'm sure you've gathered by now, Commander {AccountData.NickName},

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: will not only be your examiner, but your acting commander during the practical portion of the exam as well.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I knew it!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I was stoked at the thought of having Teach come along, I didn't think it would actually happen.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Commander, you will be taking on the role of a commanding officer

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: for a total of four students:

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: including Tercera, a third-year student from Class P who isn't present right now.
Okay. I'll do my best.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: It is worth noting that this year's exam

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: will not take place on the surface, but in the school's training room.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: We're not going to the surface?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Not this time, no.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Phew, that's awesome!

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Don't get too complacent.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Don't forget that although the exam will not be held on the surface,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: the danger is still very real.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: If you find yourself in a sticky situation, no one will lend assistance.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: So, just like every other exam you've partaken in before this,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: make sure you are well prepared.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Got it. I'm good at making preparations.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Noted.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I'll see you all at the designated time.
Marciana leaves the classroom.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: You okay, Teach? You haven't said anything for a while.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Are you nervous?
How are you all so calm?
You never know what might happen during the exam.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: What of it?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: We're used to it by now.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: This isn't the first time we've done an exam, after all.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Plus, this time we're not even going up to the surface.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: It's way easier.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: So don't be too nervous, Teach.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: This is easy-peasy for us.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Totally.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I never expected someone famous like you to be our commander.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Usually it's someone who hasn't had any experience whatsoever.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Yeah, more often than not it's someone who hasn't even been up to the surface before.
Why is that?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: The more competent the commander, the harder it is to assess the students' unique abilities.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: If the commander is exceptional, it's difficult to tell whether the students are doing well,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: or if it's a matter of the commander leading them exceptionally well.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Therefore, they mostly assign newcomers who have just become commanders, or those who haven't amounted to much.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: There's also a fair chance of the commanders perishing during the exam.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Why would an accomplished commander put themselves in danger like that?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: This begs the question... does someone at the school have a grudge against you or something?
I wish I knew.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Either way, I'm happy that you're here.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It's great that we'll be taking the exam together.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I'm happy that you're here too, Teach.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Same.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Don't you worry about a thing, Teacher.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I've got this in the bag.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I'm a senior, so I've done this plenty of times before.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: All you need to do

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: is just trust me.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Narus and I will protect you.
Much appreciated.
